name: lunch-api

dependencies.name: slack
dependencies.description: Posts a message to the team's Slack channel when a round opens or reaches its cutoff.

description: The API that owns rounds and items: opening and closing a round, adding and editing items before cutoff, and producing the consolidated order once a round closes. Runs the background check that closes a round at its cutoff and triggers the Slack cutoff message. Does not render any UI and holds no Slack channel configuration beyond the webhook URL.
